Dokument je záväzná špecifikácia pre implementáciu.")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF
cat > CLAUDE.md <<'EOF'
# CLAUDE.md – pravidlá projektu (platia pre všetkých agentov)

Rezervačný systém tenisového klubu (zadanie InQool). Záväzná špecifikácia je `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
(všetky otvorené otázky v sekcii 9 sú rozhodnuté tak, ako je tam napísané). Zadanie: `docs/zadanie.md`.
Čítaj iba tie sekcie ARCHITECTURE.md, ktoré tvoja úloha potrebuje.

## Tvrdé pravidlá (porušenie = neakceptovaný výsledok)

1. **Spring Data JPA je zakázané.** Žiadny `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`, žiadny import z `org.springframework.data..`
   (ani `Page`, `Sort`, `Pageable`, auditing). DAO vrstva používa výhradne `jakarta.persistence.EntityManager` + JPQL,
   cez generický `AbstractDao<T extends BaseEntity>`. Maven enforcer aj ArchUnit test to vynucujú.
2. **Vrstvy:** `controller` → `service` → `dao`. Controller nikdy nesiaha na `dao` ani `entity`, nikdy nevracia ani
   neprijíma entitu (iba DTO `record`y). `@Transactional` iba v `service`. `EntityManager` iba v `dao`.
3. **Soft delete:** nikdy `em.remove()`. Všetky entity dedia `BaseEntity` (`deleted`, `deletedAt`). Každý JPQL dotaz
   explicitne filtruje `e.deleted = false`. Žiadne Hibernate `@SQLDelete`/`@Where`/`@SoftDelete`.
4. **Testy sú súčasťou každej úlohy**, nie samostatný krok. JaCoCo limit 90 % (INSTRUCTION aj LINE) beží vo
   `./mvnw verify` a musí prejsť. Vylúčená je iba main trieda `TennisClubApplication`.
5. Všetky endpointy pod `/api`. Chyby ako RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail`: 400 validácia (aj prekrývanie rezervácie),
   404 neexistuje/zmazané, 409 konflikt stavu, 401 chýbajúci/neplatný token, 403 nedostatočná rola.

## Stack

Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5.x, Maven (`./mvnw`), Hibernate 6 (cez `spring-boot-starter-jdbc` + `hibernate-core` +
`spring-orm`), H2 in-memory, Liquibase (schéma výhradne z changelogu, `ddl-auto=validate`), Lombok
(entity iba `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor`, nikdy `@Data` na entite; `lombok.config` má
`lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation=true`), Spring Security 6 + `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server`
(Nimbus JWT, HS256), springdoc-openapi, JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, ArchUnit.

## Konvencie

- Koreňový balík `sk.knizat.tennisclub`; balíky podľa vrstiev: `config`, `controller`, `dto`, `mapper`, `service`
  (+ `service.impl`), `dao` (+ `dao.impl`), `entity`, `exception`, `security`. Štruktúra je v ARCHITECTURE.md §4.
- DTO sú Java `record`y s Bean Validation anotáciami. Mapovanie entita↔DTO ručne v `mapper` (bez MapStruct).
- Service aj DAO majú interface + impl. Konštruktorová injekcia (`@RequiredArgsConstructor`), žiadny `@Autowired` na poliach.
- Čas: `Instant` v API (ISO-8601) aj v entitách; „teraz“ vždy cez injektovaný `java.time.Clock` (bean v configu), nikdy `Instant.now()` v biznis kóde.
- Peniaze: `BigDecimal`, scale 2, `HALF_UP`.
- Telefónne číslo: pred validáciou aj uložením odstrániť medzery a pomlčky, potom regex `^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$`.
- Konfigurácia: prefix `app.*` cez `@ConfigurationProperties` record `AppProperties` (viď ARCHITECTURE.md §6).
- Javadoc na verejných triedach a netriviálnych metódach, stručný. Komentáre a dokumentácia v angličtine, kód v angličtine.
- Žiadne `System.out`, používaj SLF4J.
- Testy: názvy metód `should_<expected>_when_<condition>`; unit testy s Mockito bez Spring kontextu, kde sa dá.
  Testovacie profily: `src/test/resources/application-test.yml` (aktivovaný `@ActiveProfiles("test")`).
- Nemeň `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` bez explicitného pokynu. Ak narazíš na nejasnosť, rozhodni sa podľa ARCHITECTURE.md
  a napíš to do svojej záverečnej správy.

## Overenie práce

Pred odovzdaním vždy spusti `./mvnw -q verify` (kompilácia, testy, ArchUnit, JaCoCo 90 %) a odovzdaj až keď prejde.
Nekomituj – commit robí hlavný agent po revízii.
EOF

package sk.knizat.tennisclub.config;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated;

import java.time.Duration;

/**
 * Application configuration bound from the {@code app.*} prefix.
 *
 * @param dataInit data initialization switch
 * @param security security related settings (JWT, bootstrap admin)
 */
@Validated
@ConfigurationProperties("app")
public record AppProperties(
        @NotNull @Valid DataInit dataInit,
        @NotNull @Valid Security security) {

    /**
     * Initial data switch: when enabled, default surface types and courts are created at startup.
     *
     * @param enabled whether initial data should be created
     */
    public record DataInit(boolean enabled) {
    }

    /**
     * Security settings.
     *
     * @param jwt JWT token settings
     * @param admin bootstrap administrator account settings
     */
    public record Security(
            @NotNull @Valid Jwt jwt,
            @NotNull @Valid Admin admin) {

        /**
         * JWT (HS256) settings.
         *
         * @param secret shared secret, at least 32 bytes
         * @param accessTokenValidity validity of access tokens
         * @param refreshTokenValidity validity of refresh tokens
         */
        public record Jwt(
                @NotBlank String secret,
                @NotNull Duration accessTokenValidity,
                @NotNull Duration refreshTokenValidity) {
        }

        /**
         * Bootstrap ADMIN account created at startup when enabled.
         *
         * @param enabled whether the admin account should be created
         * @param phoneNumber admin login (phone number)
         * @param name admin display name
         * @param password admin raw password
         */
        public record Admin(
                boolean enabled,
                @NotBlank String phoneNumber,
                @NotBlank String name,
                @NotBlank String password) {
        }
    }
}

package sk.knizat.tennisclub.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.bind.validation.BindValidationException;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.runner.ApplicationContextRunner;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

import java.time.Duration;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class AppPropertiesTest {

    private static final String[] VALID = {
            "app.data-init.enabled=true",
            "app.security.jwt.secret=0123456789012345678901234567890123",
            "app.security.jwt.access-token-validity=PT15M",
            "app.security.jwt.refresh-token-validity=P7D",
            "app.security.admin.enabled=true",
            "app.security.admin.phone-number=+420000000000",
            "app.security.admin.name=Administrator",
            "app.security.admin.password=admin"};

    private final ApplicationContextRunner runner = new ApplicationContextRunner()
            .withUserConfiguration(PropertiesConfig.class);

    @Test
    void should_bindAllNestedProperties_when_configurationIsValid() {
        runner.withPropertyValues(VALID).run(ctx -> {
            AppProperties props = ctx.getBean(AppProperties.class);
            assertThat(props.dataInit().enabled()).isTrue();
            assertThat(props.security().jwt().secret()).isEqualTo("0123456789012345678901234567890123");
            assertThat(props.security().jwt().accessTokenValidity()).isEqualTo(Duration.ofMinutes(15));
            assertThat(props.security().jwt().refreshTokenValidity()).isEqualTo(Duration.ofDays(7));
            assertThat(props.security().admin().enabled()).isTrue();
            assertThat(props.security().admin().phoneNumber()).isEqualTo("+420000000000");
            assertThat(props.security().admin().name()).isEqualTo("Administrator");
            assertThat(props.security().admin().password()).isEqualTo("admin");
        });
    }

                .run(ctx -> assertThat(ctx).hasFailed()

                        "app.security.jwt.access-token-validity=PT15M",
                        "app.security.jwt.refresh-token-validity=P7D")
                .run(ctx -> assertThat(ctx).hasFailed()
                        .getFailure().hasRootCauseInstanceOf(BindValidationException.class));
    }

    @Configuration
    @EnableConfigurationProperties(AppProperties.class)
    static class PropertiesConfig {
    }
}

1	# Architektúra – Rezervačný systém tenisového klubu
2	
3	Návrh riešenia zadania v `docs/zadanie.md` (originál `docs/zadanie.docx`), vrátane všetkých bonusov.
4	Dokument je návrh na diskusiu, kód sa zatiaľ nepíše. Sekcia [Otvorené otázky](#9-otvorené-otázky) obsahuje
5	všetko, čo zadanie nešpecifikuje, s mojím odporúčaním.
6	
7	**Stav:** všetky odporúčania v sekcii 9 boli odsúhlasené (jediná zmena: O-14, telefónne číslo). Dokument je záväzná špecifikácia pre implementáciu.
8	
9	Fixné požiadavky (nie sú predmetom diskusie):
10	
11	| # | Požiadavka |
12	|---|------------|
13	| 1 | DAO vrstva výhradne cez `EntityManager` + JPQL, generický `AbstractDao`. Spring Data JPA zakázané, vynútené ArchUnit testom. |
14	| 2 | Vrstvy controller → service → dao. DTO na hraniciach, entita nikdy v response. |
15	| 3 | Soft delete cez `BaseEntity` + explicitné filtrovanie v DAO. |
16	| 4 | Java 21, Spring Boot 3, H2, Maven, JaCoCo s limitom 90 % vo fáze `verify`. |
17	| 5 | Unit testy súčasťou každého kroku, nie na konci. |
18	
19	---
20	
21	## 1. Technologický stack
22	
23	| Oblasť | Voľba | Poznámka |
24	|--------|-------|----------|
25	| Jazyk / build | Java 21, Maven | Maven wrapper (`mvnw`) v repozitári |
26	| Framework | Spring Boot 3.5.x | posledná 3.x línia |
27	| Web | `spring-boot-starter-web`, `spring-boot-starter-validation` | REST + Bean Validation |
28	| ORM | Hibernate 6 cez `spring-boot-starter-jdbc` + `hibernate-core` + `spring-orm` | **nie** `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa` (ťahá Spring Data). Auto-konfigurácia `HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration` funguje aj bez Spring Data. |
29	| DB | H2 in-memory | `jdbc:h2:mem:tennis` |
30	| Migrácie | Liquibase (bonus) | `ddl-auto=validate`, schéma výhradne z changelogu |
31	| Boilerplate | Lombok (bonus) | `lombok.config` s `lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation=true` (JaCoCo ignoruje generovaný kód) |
32	| Security | Spring Security 6 + `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server` (Nimbus JWT, HS256) | bez tretej JWT knižnice, viď otázka O-11 |
33	| API dokumentácia | springdoc-openapi | Swagger UI, viď otázka O-19 |
34	| Testy | JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, Spring Boot Test, ArchUnit | |
35	| Coverage | JaCoCo, `check` viazaný na `verify`, minimum 90 % | |
36	| Enforcement | maven-enforcer-plugin `bannedDependencies` na `org.springframework.data:*` | druhá poistka popri ArchUnit |
37	
38	---
39	
40	## 2. Dátový model
41	
42	### 2.1 Prehľad
43	
44	```mermaid
45	classDiagram
46	    class BaseEntity {
47	        <<MappedSuperclass>>
48	        +Long id
49	        +Instant createdAt
50	        +Instant updatedAt
51	        +boolean deleted
52	        +Instant deletedAt
53	    }
54	    class SurfaceType {
55	        +String name
56	        +BigDecimal pricePerMinute
57	    }
58	    class Court {
59	        +Integer courtNumber
60	        +String name
61	    }
62	    class User {
63	        +String phoneNumber
64	        +String name
65	        +String passwordHash
66	        +Role role
67	    }
68	    class Reservation {
69	        +Instant startTime
70	        +Instant endTime
71	        +GameType gameType
72	        +BigDecimal price
73	    }
74	    class Role {
75	        <<enumeration>>
76	        USER
77	        ADMIN
78	    }
79	    class GameType {
80	        <<enumeration>>
81	        SINGLES
82	        DOUBLES
83	    }
84	    BaseEntity <|-- SurfaceType
85	    BaseEntity <|-- Court
86	    BaseEntity <|-- User
87	    BaseEntity <|-- Reservation
88	    Court "*" --> "1" SurfaceType : surfaceType
89	    Reservation "*" --> "1" Court : court
90	    Reservation "*" --> "1" User : user
91	    User --> Role
92	    Reservation --> GameType
93	```
94	
95	### 2.2 Entity
96	
97	**`BaseEntity`** (`@MappedSuperclass`)
98	
99	| Atribút | Typ | Poznámka |
100	|---------|-----|----------|
101	| `id` | `Long`, `@GeneratedValue(IDENTITY)` | |
102	| `createdAt` | `Instant` | nastaví `@PrePersist` (nie Spring Data auditing) |
103	| `updatedAt` | `Instant` | nastaví `@PreUpdate` |
104	| `deleted` | `boolean`, default `false` | soft delete flag |
105	| `deletedAt` | `Instant`, nullable | čas zmazania |
106	
107	Metóda `markDeleted()` nastaví `deleted=true` a `deletedAt=now`. `equals/hashCode` podľa `id` (bez Lombok `@Data`; entity budú mať iba `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor`).
108	
109	**`SurfaceType`** – číselník povrchov, spravovateľný cez API
110	
111	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
112	|---------|-----|------------|
113	| `name` | `String` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými |
114	| `pricePerMinute` | `BigDecimal(10,2)` | povinné, `>= 0` |
115	
116	**`Court`**
117	
118	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
119	|---------|-----|------------|
120	| `courtNumber` | `Integer` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými, biznisový identifikátor z API ("unikátne číslo kurtu") |
121	| `name` | `String` | nepovinné (napr. „Centre court“) |
122	| `surfaceType` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné, iba nezmazaný povrch |
123	
124	**`User`** – zákazník aj systémový účet v jednom (viď O-1)
125	
126	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
127	|---------|-----|------------|
128	| `phoneNumber` | `String` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými, login identifikátor |
129	| `name` | `String` | povinné |
130	| `passwordHash` | `String`, nullable | BCrypt; `null` = účet nemôže sa prihlásiť (zákazník vytvorený rezerváciou) |
131	| `role` | `enum Role {USER, ADMIN}` | default `USER` |
132	
133	**`Reservation`**
134	
135	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
136	|---------|-----|------------|
137	| `court` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné |
138	| `user` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné (zákazník) |
139	| `startTime`, `endTime` | `Instant` | `start < end`, polootvorený interval `[start, end)` |
140	| `gameType` | `enum GameType {SINGLES, DOUBLES}` | povinné |
141	| `price` | `BigDecimal(10,2)` | snapshot vypočítanej ceny v čase vzniku/úpravy (viď O-6) |

   - `SurfaceType` → table `surface_type` (`name` varchar 100 not null, `price_per_minute` decimal(10,2) not null).
   - `Court` → table `court` (`court_number` int not null, `name` varchar 100 nullable, `surface_type_id` FK not null).
   - `User` → table `app_user` (`phone_number` varchar 20 not null, `name` varchar 100 not null, `password_hash` varchar 100 nullable, `role` varchar 20 not null).
   - `Reservation` → table `reservation` (`court_id` FK, `user_id` FK, `start_time`/`end_time` timestamp with time zone not null, `game_type` varchar 20 not null, `price` decimal(10,2) not null).
   - Common columns from BaseEntity on every table: `id` bigint identity PK, `created_at`, `updated_at` timestamp with time zone not null, `deleted` boolean not null default false, `deleted_at` timestamp with time zone nullable.

Liquibase: `src/main/resources/db/changelog/db.changelog-master.yaml` including `db/changelog/changes/001-initial-schema.yaml` with changeSets (author `tennisclub`) creating the 4 tables, FKs, and indexes: `idx_reservation_court_time (court_id, start_time, end_time)`, `idx_app_user_phone (phone_number)`, `idx_court_number (court_number)`. 5. Tests (all must follow `should_<expected>_when_<condition>` naming):
   - Pure unit test `entity/BaseEntityTest` (no Spring): `markDeleted` sets flags, `onCreate`/`onUpdate` behaviour (call the callback methods directly), `equals/hashCode` contract (same id equal, different id not equal, null id only self-equal, different class not equal), `toString`.
   - Unit tests for the entities' trivial behaviour are unnecessary (Lombok getters/setters are excluded from JaCoCo via `@Generated`), but the callback and equals code must be covered.
   - Integration test `entity/SchemaValidationTest`: `@SpringBootTest` + `@ActiveProfiles("test")` that proves Liquibase created the schema and Hibernate validated it (context loads), and additionally, using the injected `EntityManagerFactory` or `JdbcTemplate`, asserts the 4 tables exist (e.g. query `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES`). Also persist one full object graph (surface type → court → user → reservation) inside a `TransactionTemplate` / `@Transactional` test and read it back with `em.find`, checking `createdAt`/`updatedAt` were filled by the callbacks. Use `EntityManager` only inside the test (tests are excluded from ArchUnit). You may obtain an `EntityManager` via `EntityManagerFactory#createEntityManager()` with a manual transaction, or `@PersistenceContext` + `@Transactional` on the test class (Spring's `PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` supports that).

## Verification (mandatory)

Run `./mvnw -q verify`; it must pass: compilation, all tests, ArchUnit, JaCoCo ≥ 90 % (INSTRUCTION and LINE). If coverage drops below 90 % because of entity code, add real unit tests rather than exclusions. Do not change the threshold.

## Final report (under 40 lines)

Files created/changed, the `./mvnw verify` outcome with test count, the Liquibase column types you ended up with for `Instant` columns, and any decisions or deviations from the spec with reasons.

input.prompt:
You are a strict code reviewer. Repo: `/home/user/inqool_zadanie`. **Do NOT modify any file. Do NOT commit.** You only produce a findings list.

Context: Step 1 (JPA entities, enums, Liquibase schema) of a Spring Boot 3.5 / Java 21 project was just implemented by another agent on top of a committed Step 0 skeleton. Read `CLAUDE.md` (project rules) and ONLY §2 (Dátový model incl. 2.4) and the Step 1 row of §8 of `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Then review every uncommitted file (`git status --porcelain`; `git diff` for modified ones): everything under `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/`, `src/main/resources/db/changelog/`, `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/`.

Check specifically:
1. **Spec conformance** of every entity vs. §2.2: field names, types, nullability, lengths, `@Enumerated(STRING)`, `@ManyToOne(LAZY, optional=false)`, table/column names, `User` role default, `Reservation.price` scale, no unique constraints on business keys, no `@Where/@SQLDelete/@SoftDelete`, Lombok only `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor` (no `@Data`, `@EqualsAndHashCode`, `@ToString`).
2. **BaseEntity**: `equals/hashCode` correctness for JPA (Hibernate proxies! `getClass()` comparison breaks with lazy proxies — check whether they used `Hibernate.getClass()` or `instanceof`; with `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` proxies of `Court`/`SurfaceType` will be compared later), hashCode stability across persist (should not change when id is assigned if the entity is in a HashSet — evaluate the trade-off they chose and whether it is documented), callbacks (`@PrePersist/@PreUpdate`) semantics, `markDeleted(Instant)`, where `Instant.now()` is used.
3. **Liquibase changelog**: types compatible with Hibernate `ddl-auto=validate` (already passing, but check for latent issues: `decimal(10,2)` precision vs `@Column(precision, scale)`, varchar lengths equal to `@Column(length)`, `timestamp with time zone`, `deleted` default and not-null), FK names, indexes match §2.4, changeSet ids/authors unique, `runOnChange`/`preconditions` not misused, YAML validity.
4. **Tests**: real assertions (not tautologies), naming `should_<expected>_when_<condition>`, the schema test uses a fresh EntityManager for read-back (otherwise `find` hits the first-level cache and proves nothing), transaction handling correct (no leaked open transactions/EntityManagers), no reliance on test execution order, no test pollution risk for later steps (shared in-memory DB across the Spring test context: does the persisted data leak? Is that acceptable or should the test be `@Transactional` with rollback / `@DirtiesContext`?).
5. Anything that will bite later steps: e.g. missing `@Column(nullable=false)` on `deleted` making `validate` fine but inserts fail, `BigDecimal` scale handling, `Instant` vs H2 timezone, `User` class name clashing with `org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User` in step 7 (worth a note), entity constructors needed by services/tests.

Run `./mvnw -q verify` once to confirm the state and report the result.

Output: a numbered list of findings, each with **severity** (BLOCKER / MAJOR / MINOR / NIT), file:line, what is wrong, concrete fix. Then one line "Build: PASS/FAIL". Do not list things that are fine. No praise.

content.text:
**Findings**

1. **MAJOR** – `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/BaseEntity.java:88, 92, 97` – `equals`/`hashCode` are not proxy-safe. `getClass() != o.getClass()` returns `false` for `court` vs `court$HibernateProxy$…` (every `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` target — `Court`, `SurfaceType`, `User` — will be a proxy from step 2 on), `other.id` reads the *field* of a proxy, which is always `null` (proxies only populate through getters), and `Objects.hash(getClass(), id)` gives a different hash for proxy and real instance of the same row. Fix:
   ```java
   if (o == null || Hibernate.getClass(this) != Hibernate.getClass(o)) return false;
   Long otherId = ((BaseEntity) o).getId();
   return id != null && id.equals(otherId);
   // hashCode: Objects.hash(Hibernate.getClass(this), id) : System.identityHashCode(this)
   ```
   Add a unit test with an anonymous subclass (`new SurfaceType() {}`) carrying the same id to cover the proxy path (`Hibernate.getClass` unwraps `HibernateProxy` only, so use a real proxy via `em.getReference` in `SchemaValidationTest`, or at minimum document the subclass limitation).

2. **MAJOR** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/SchemaValidationTest.java:57-90` – the test commits a `SurfaceType("Clay")`, `Court(1)`, `User(+421900000001)` and a `Reservation` into the shared `jdbc:h2:mem:tennis;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1` DB. All `@SpringBootTest @ActiveProfiles("test")` classes share the cached context and therefore this DB; any later DAO/e2e test that asserts counts, "court number 1 is free", or "phone number unused" becomes order-dependent. Fix: make the test `@Transactional`, inject `@PersistenceContext EntityManager em`, persist, then `em.flush(); em.clear();` before `em.find(...)` (clear empties the first-level cache so the read-back is real), and let Spring roll back. Alternatively keep the current resource-local approach but delete the rows in a `finally` via `jdbcTemplate` (reservation → court → app_user → surface_type).

3. **MINOR** – `BaseEntity.java:97` – `hashCode` switches from `identityHashCode` to `hash(class, id)` when the id is assigned on persist, so an entity put in a `HashSet`/`HashMap` key before `persist` is lost afterwards. That trade-off is neither documented in the Javadoc nor tested. Either document it ("do not put transient entities into hash-based collections") or use the stable variant `return Hibernate.getClass(this).hashCode();` (all rows of one entity type collide, which is acceptable for entity sets).

4. **MINOR** – `BaseEntity.java:54, 66` – `Instant.now()` in `@PrePersist/@PreUpdate` is a documented deviation from CLAUDE.md ("never `Instant.now()` in business code; use injected `Clock`"). It is not strictly necessary: Spring Boot registers `SpringBeanContainer`, so a Spring-managed `@Component class AuditListener { private final Clock clock; @PrePersist void onCreate(BaseEntity e) {...} }` referenced via `@EntityListeners(AuditListener.class)` on `BaseEntity` gets the `Clock` injected. This also makes `createdAt` deterministic in tests. If the deviation is kept, mention it explicitly in the step report.

5. **MINOR** – `BaseEntity.java:102` – `toString` uses `getClass().getSimpleName()`; for lazy proxies it prints `Court$HibernateProxy$…{id=…}`. Use `Hibernate.getClass(this).getSimpleName()`.

6. **MINOR** – `BaseEntity.java:29-30` – Lombok `@Setter` on the class exposes `setId`, `setCreatedAt`, `setUpdatedAt`, `setDeleted`, `setDeletedAt`, which lets services bypass `markDeleted` and overwrite audit fields. Put `@Setter(AccessLevel.NONE)` on those fields (or make the setters package-private/protected); the tests only need `setId` (keep it package-private or use reflection/`ReflectionTestUtils`).

7. **NIT** – `BaseEntity.java:74` – `markDeleted(Instant)` deviates from the spec signature `markDeleted()` (§2.2). The deviation is correct given the `Clock` rule, but it is not called out anywhere; put it in the step report so the ARCHITECTURE owner can align the doc. Also consider making it idempotent (`if (deleted) return;`) so a repeated delete does not overwrite `deletedAt`.

8. **NIT** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/BaseEntityTest.java:89` – `assertThat(a.hashCode()).isEqualTo(a.hashCode())` is a tautology. Replace with an assertion that has content, e.g. that the hash is unchanged after a second call and differs from `b`'s identity hash, or drop it.

9. **NIT** – `src/main/resources/db/changelog/changes/001-initial-schema.yaml:28 etc.` – `timestamp with time zone` is created with H2's default precision 6 (microseconds), while `Instant.now()` on JDK 21/Linux carries microsecond-to-nanosecond precision. Round-tripping `createdAt` will silently truncate. Nothing fails today (the schema test only asserts `isNotNull`), but for later steps the test `Clock` must be fixed to whole milliseconds/seconds (`Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("…Z"), UTC)`) and equality assertions on `createdAt/updatedAt` should be avoided or use `truncatedTo`.

10. **NIT** – `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/entity/User.java:21` – `User` will clash with `org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User` in step 7. Not a problem now, but the security adapter should be named e.g. `AppUserDetails`/`JwtPrincipal` and import the entity by FQN where both are needed, rather than renaming the entity later.

**Spec conformance otherwise OK**: field names/types/nullability/lengths match §2.2, `@Enumerated(STRING)` present, `@ManyToOne(LAZY, optional=false)` + `nullable=false` join columns, `role = Role.USER` default, `precision=10, scale=2` matches `decimal(10,2)`, no unique constraints on business keys, no `@Where/@SQLDelete/@SoftDelete`, Lombok limited to `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor`, Liquibase ids/authors unique, FK names and the three §2.4 indexes present, `deleted` NOT NULL with default false, changelog YAML valid, no `runOnChange`/preconditions, read-back in the schema test uses a fresh `EntityManager`.

Build: PASS (`./mvnw -q verify` exit 0)

These guard the 409 on court/user deletion (O-9 "budúce nezmazané rezervácie"). With `startTime > now`, a reservation that is *currently in progress* (started 10 min ago, ends in 50 min) does not block deleting the court/user, and a reservation starting exactly at `now` does not either. §9 line 469 defines `futureOnly = startTime > now` only for the *listing* filter ("prebiehajúca rezervácia nie je v budúcnosti"); it says nothing about the deletion guard. Ambiguous in the spec. **Recommendation:** for the deletion guard use `r.endTime > :now` (a not-yet-finished reservation blocks deletion — ongoing play on a court being deleted is the case you most want to prevent), keep `startTime > now` for `findByPhoneNumber(futureOnly)`. Rename to `existsUnfinishedByCourt/User` or document the chosen predicate in the Javadoc and in the final report; update `ReservationDaoTest:224/236` (`start == now is not future`) accordingly.

2. **MINOR** — `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/dao/AbstractDao.java:97-103` `singleResult` uses `setMaxResults(1)`. The schema has no unique constraints (only plain indexes on `phone_number`, `court_number`), so two non-deleted users with the same phone / two active courts with one number are physically possible (race in Step 5 "find-or-create customer"). `setMaxResults(1)` with no `ORDER BY` silently returns an arbitrary one instead of surfacing the inconsistency. **Fix:** drop `setMaxResults(1)`, use `getResultList()` and throw `IllegalStateException`/`NonUniqueResultException` when `size() > 1` (or at least add `ORDER BY e.id` to the callers so the result is deterministic).

3. **MINOR** — `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/dao/GenericDao.java:40` and `ReservationDao.java:23`: signatures deviate from §3.1 (`softDelete(T entity)` → `softDelete(T, Instant now)`; `findByPhoneNumber(phone, futureOnly)` → `(phone, futureOnly, now)`). The deviations are justified by the "now only via injected `Clock`" rule and by "no Clock in DAO", but they are spec deviations and must be listed in the step report (CLAUDE.md: "napíš to do svojej záverečnej správy"); `ARCHITECTURE.md` must not be silently out of sync.

This will bite Step 3/4 if a service does `mapper.toEntity(dto); e.setId(id); dao.save(e)`. **Fix:** document in `GenericDao.save` Javadoc that updates must be done load-then-modify (managed entity), or make `save` reject `id != null && !em.contains(entity)` unless explicitly merging; add a test in a later step.

You are implementing **Step 5 (reservations: price calculator, creation with customer find-or-create and overlap check under a court lock, RUD, list filters + tests)** of a Spring Boot 3.5 / Java 21 project in `/home/user/inqool_zadanie`. Steps 0–4 are committed and `./mvnw verify` passes (171 tests, ~100 % coverage). Read `CLAUDE.md` first (note: phone normalisation rule, `Clock` rule, `BigDecimal` rule). Then read ONLY these parts of `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: §2.2 (`User`, `Reservation`), §2.3 (business rules), §5.4 (Rezervácie endpoints — this is the contract), §3.2, the Step 5 row of §8, and in §9 the decided questions O-2, O-5, O-6, O-7, O-10, O-12, O-13, O-14, O-15, O-25. **Follow the existing Step 3/4 code as the pattern**, study: `service/impl/CourtServiceImpl`, `controller/CourtController`, `mapper/CourtMapper`, `dto/court/*`, `controller/GlobalExceptionHandler`, `exception/*`, and the DAO contracts `dao/ReservationDao`, `dao/CourtDao` (`findByCourtNumber`, `findByIdForUpdate` = PESSIMISTIC_WRITE), `dao/UserDao` (`findByPhoneNumber`), `dao/GenericDao`. Tests to mirror: `service/impl/CourtServiceImplTest`, `controller/CourtControllerTest`, `controller/CourtApiTest` (extends `support/AbstractApiTest` which gives `rest`, `clock` (`MutableClock`), `jdbcTemplate`, clock reset and DB cleanup), `support/Fixtures`. Do not modify `docs/`, `pom.xml`, entities, the ArchUnit test, or Step 3/4 production classes. You MAY add methods to DAOs only if strictly necessary (prefer not). Do not commit.

## Deliverables

1. **`service/PriceCalculator`** (`@Component`, pure, no state): `BigDecimal calculate(Instant start, Instant end, BigDecimal pricePerMinute, GameType gameType)` = whole minutes × pricePerMinute × (`DOUBLES_MULTIPLIER = 1.5` for DOUBLES), `setScale(2, HALF_UP)`. Constant public for tests. Javadoc.
2. **Phone normalisation** — a small `service/PhoneNumberNormalizer` (or a static util in `dto`? No: put it in `service` package as `@Component` or a `final` util class `service/PhoneNumbers`) that removes all whitespace and hyphens; validation of the normalised value against `^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$` is done by Bean Validation on the DTO? Bean Validation runs before normalisation, so: DTO field gets `@NotBlank` + `@Pattern(regexp = "^\\+?[0-9 \\-]{7,25}$")` (loose, allows spaces/hyphens), and the service normalises and then checks the strict regex `^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$`, throwing `ValidationException` (400) if it fails. Document this two-stage approach in Javadoc.
3. **Reservation config**: add to `config/AppProperties` a nested record `Reservation(Duration minDuration, Duration maxDuration)` bound from `app.reservation.min-duration` (default `PT15M`) / `app.reservation.max-duration` (default `PT4H`) — add the keys to `application.yml` (and `application-test.yml` if needed), update `README.md` configuration table, and extend `config/AppPropertiesTest` (`VALID` array + assertions). Keep `@NotNull @Valid`.
4. **DTOs** `dto/reservation/`: `CreateReservationRequest(Integer courtNumber, Instant startTime, Instant endTime, GameType gameType, String phoneNumber, String customerName)` (`@NotNull` on all, `@Positive` court number, `@NotBlank @Size(max=100)` customer name, phone as above); `UpdateReservationRequest(Integer courtNumber, Instant startTime, Instant endTime, GameType gameType)`; `ReservationResponse(Long id, Integer courtNumber, String courtName, Instant startTime, Instant endTime, GameType gameType, BigDecimal price, CustomerResponse customer, Instant createdAt)` with nested record `CustomerResponse(String phoneNumber, String name)` (put it in `dto/reservation/` too). `GameType` enum is in `entity` — DTOs must not depend on `entity`? ArchUnit forbids only `controller` → `entity`. But the controller handles `ReservationResponse` whose field type is `entity.GameType`; rule 4 checks raw return/parameter types of controller methods only, so it would pass, but conceptually the API should not expose the entity enum. **Create `dto/reservation/GameTypeDto`? No — simpler and cleaner: keep `GameType` as the API enum by moving nothing; instead declare a DTO-level enum `dto/reservation/GameTypeDto`? Decision: create `dto/GameTypeDto { SINGLES, DOUBLES }` and map it in the mapper (`GameType.valueOf(dto.name())`). Yes, do this.**
5. **`mapper/ReservationMapper`** (`@Component`): `toResponse(Reservation)` (reads `court.courtNumber`, `court.name`, `user.phoneNumber`, `user.name`, price, createdAt; maps enums), enum helpers `toEntity(GameTypeDto)` / `toDto(GameType)`.
6. **`service/ReservationService`** + **`service/impl/ReservationServiceImpl`** (`@Service @Transactional @RequiredArgsConstructor`, `Clock`, `AppProperties`, `PriceCalculator`, DAOs, mapper):
   - `ReservationResponse create(CreateReservationRequest)`: validate interval (`start < end`, `start >= now`, duration within `[minDuration, maxDuration]`, `start`/`end` truncated/required to whole minutes → if seconds/nanos != 0 → 400) → 400 `ValidationException` with precise messages; resolve court by **courtNumber** via `courtDao.findByCourtNumber` (404 `NotFoundException.of("Court", courtNumber)` — document that here the identifier is the court number); **lock**: `courtDao.findByIdForUpdate(court.getId())` (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE, serialises concurrent creates on one court); overlap: `reservationDao.existsOverlapping(courtId, start, end, null)` → 400 `ValidationException("Reservation overlaps with an existing reservation on court N")` (O-10); customer: normalise phone, `userDao.findByPhoneNumber(phone)` or create `User(phone, name, role USER, passwordHash null)` via `userDao.save` (O-13: existing user's name is kept, request name ignored); price via calculator using `court.getSurfaceType().getPricePerMinute()`; save; return response including price (O-6 snapshot).
   - `findById(Long)` 404; `findAll(Integer courtNumber, String phoneNumber, Boolean futureOnly)` — filters per §5.4: `courtNumber` only → `findByCourtNumberOrderByCreatedAt` (404? No: unknown court number → **empty list**, document); `phoneNumber` (normalised) → `findByPhoneNumber(phone, futureOnly, now)`; both → intersect in memory (filter the phone list by court number), keep the phone list ordering; none → `findAllOrderByStartTime` (apply `futureOnly` in memory if true). Document.
   - `update(Long, UpdateReservationRequest)`: 404; same interval validation; resolve+lock target court; overlap excluding own id; recalc price; customer unchanged (O-12).
   - `delete(Long)`: 404; soft delete with `clock.instant()`.
   - `start >= now` rule for update as well (a reservation cannot be moved into the past). Document.
7. **`controller/ReservationController`** (`/api/reservations`): `POST` 201 + Location, `GET` with optional `@RequestParam courtNumber`, `phoneNumber`, `futureOnly` (default false), `GET /{id}`, `PUT /{id}`, `DELETE /{id}` 204. springdoc annotations minimal. Bean validation on query params is not needed.
8. **Lock timeout**: H2 default lock timeout is 1 s. Set `spring.jpa.properties.jakarta.persistence.lock.timeout: 5000` in `application.yml` (document) and map Spring's `org.springframework.dao.PessimisticLockingFailureException` / `CannotAcquireLockException` to **409** `ProblemDetail` "Conflict" in `GlobalExceptionHandler` (add one `@ExceptionHandler`; this is the only allowed change to Step 3 code).
9. **Tests** (all `should_<expected>_when_<condition>`, coverage ≥ 90 % overall, aim 100 % for new code):
   - `service/PriceCalculatorTest`: singles/doubles, rounding HALF_UP (e.g. 1 minute × 0.005 → 0.01; 3 minutes × 1.555 doubles), zero-length not tested here (validated earlier), long durations.
   - `service/PhoneNumbersTest` (or wherever the normaliser lives): spaces, hyphens, plus optional, invalid after normalisation.
   - `service/impl/ReservationServiceImplTest` (Mockito, fixed `Clock`, real mapper/calculator, `AppProperties` built by hand): every validation branch (start after end, in past, too short, too long, not whole minute), court not found, overlap → `ValidationException`, lock called before overlap check (use `InOrder`), existing user reused with its own name, new user created with role USER and null password, price for singles/doubles, update branches (excluding own id, price recalculated, customer untouched), delete, list filter combinations incl. in-memory intersection and futureOnly.
   - `mapper/ReservationMapperTest`.
   - `controller/ReservationControllerTest` (`@WebMvcTest(ReservationController.class)` + `@Import(SecurityConfig.class)` + `@MockitoBean ReservationService`): statuses, JSON shape (nested `customer`, `price` as number with 2 decimals, `Instant` ISO strings), query params forwarded (`verify(service).findAll(1, "+421...", true)`), validation → 400 with `errors` (missing fields, bad enum value → 400 "Malformed request"), 404/400/409 mapping incl. the new lock-failure mapping (mock throws `CannotAcquireLockException`).
   - `controller/ReservationApiTest extends AbstractApiTest`: build surface + court via APIs; scenarios: create singles (price check: 90 min × 2.00 = 180.00), create doubles (× 1.5), 201 Location, GET by id, list by courtNumber ordered by createdAt (advance clock between creates, create in reverse start order), list by phone with `futureOnly` (advance clock past the first reservation), overlap → 400 with detail, touching intervals allowed, customer reuse with different name → stored name returned, phone normalisation ("+421 900 000 001" equals "+421900000001"), update moves and recalculates price, update overlapping another → 400, delete → 204 then 404, invalid interval cases → 400.
   - **Concurrency test** (`ReservationConcurrencyTest`, `@SpringBootTest` + `@ActiveProfiles("test")` + `@Import(TestClockConfig.class)`, not `@Transactional`): two threads (`ExecutorService`, `CountDownLatch`) call `reservationService.create` for the same court and interval concurrently; assert exactly one succeeds and the other fails with `ValidationException` (overlap) — never two rows. Clean up with `JdbcTemplate` in `@AfterEach` (FK order). If the pessimistic lock makes the second thread wait and then see the overlap, that is the expected path; if H2 throws a lock timeout instead, report it.
   
## Verification (mandatory)

`./mvnw -q verify` and `./mvnw -q test -Dsurefire.runOrder=alphabetical` must both pass.

## Final report (under 45 lines)

Files created/changed, verify results (test count, coverage), the concurrency-test outcome, decisions/deviations (e.g. `GameTypeDto`, 404 vs 400 for court number, list filter semantics, lock timeout).

**Concurrency test outcome**: two threads (`ExecutorService` + `CountDownLatch`) creating the same slot on one court: exactly one `ReservationResponse`, the other a `ValidationException` "Reservation overlaps with an existing reservation on court 1", one row in DB. This is the expected lock-wait path (no lock timeout). A second scenario holds the court lock in a `TransactionTemplate` beyond the timeout and asserts the waiting `create` fails with `ConflictException` (409) — passes; the H2 error text confirms the 2000 ms URL `LOCK_TIMEOUT` governs.

**Decisions / deviations**:
1. **Lock-failure mapping lives in the service, not `GlobalExceptionHandler`.** The requested `@ExceptionHandler(PessimisticLockingFailureException)` in `controller` violates the existing ArchUnit rule `controllers_do_not_touch_dao_or_entities` (its `..dao..` pattern also matches `org.springframework.dao`), and the ArchUnit test must not be modified. `ReservationServiceImpl.lockCourt` catches Spring's translated `PessimisticLockingFailureException` (covers `CannotAcquireLockException`) and throws `ConflictException("Court with number N is locked by a concurrent reservation, please retry")` → existing 409 handler. `GlobalExceptionHandler` is therefore unchanged.
2. **H2 ignores `jakarta.persistence.lock.timeout`** (H2Dialect has no wait/timeout rendering); the property is set as requested and documented, but the effective timeout is `LOCK_TIMEOUT` in the JDBC URL (5 s prod, 2 s test to keep the timeout test fast).
3. `GameTypeDto` created in `dto/` and mapped by name in `ReservationMapper`; the API never exposes `entity.GameType`.
4. Unknown court number on create/update → **404** with message `"Court with number N not found"` (custom message instead of `NotFoundException.of`, whose "with id" wording would be misleading for a business number). In list filters an unknown `courtNumber` yields an **empty list** (a filter, not a lookup).
5. List semantics: `courtNumber` only → DAO createdAt order; `phoneNumber` → DAO startTime order with `futureOnly` in JPQL; both → phone list filtered by court in memory (keeps startTime order); no filter → startTime order. `futureOnly` (`startTime > now`) is also applied in memory for the court-only and no-filter cases, so it is combinable with any filter. Malformed `phoneNumber` filter → 400.
6. Phone: DTO `@Pattern("^\+?[0-9 \-]{7,25}$")` (loose) then `PhoneNumbers.normalise` strips whitespace/hyphens and checks `^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$` → 400 otherwise. Note for API consumers: a `+` in a query string must be percent-encoded (`%2B`), otherwise the container decodes it as a space (the API test encodes it).
7. Interval rules apply to update too (cannot move a reservation into the past); validation order: whole minutes → start<end → not in past → min → max. Update keeps the customer (O-12); existing customer keeps stored name (O-13); new customer gets `role=USER`, `passwordHash=null`, trimmed name.</result>

2. **MINOR** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/service/ReservationConcurrencyTest.java:90-131` + `src/test/resources/application-test.yml:8` – scenario 1 is timing-dependent: thread B's wait on the court row is bounded by `LOCK_TIMEOUT=2000`. If thread A holds the lock for more than 2 s (cold JIT, first-time JPQL compilation, slow CI) B gets `ConflictException` instead of the expected `ValidationException` and the test fails. Passed 3/3 here in ~ms, but the margin is a constant. Fix: keep the test-profile `LOCK_TIMEOUT` at the production 5000 (or higher) and make scenario 2 fast by lowering the timeout on the *waiting* session only (`jdbcTemplate.execute("SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 500")` is per-session in H2, so instead run scenario 2 in a nested `TransactionTemplate` whose connection first executes `SET LOCK_TIMEOUT`), or at least document the assumption in the class Javadoc.

3. **MINOR** – `ReservationServiceImpl.java:123-142` (`validateInterval`) – the "must not be in the past" rule is applied unchanged to `update`, so an ADMIN cannot change the game type / end time of a reservation that has already started (unit test `should_throwValidation_when_updateMovesIntoPast` cements this). O-5 defines the rule for an interval, O-12 only says "re-validates overlap". Not wrong per spec, but it is an undocumented product decision; state it in the final report and in `ReservationService.update` Javadoc (currently says only "moves the reservation").

4. **MINOR** – `ReservationServiceImpl.java:137,140` – validation detail exposes `Duration.toString()` (`"Reservation must last at least PT15M"`, `"at most PT4H"`). ISO-8601 duration is not a client-friendly message. Fix: `"... at least " + min.toMinutes() + " minutes"`. (e2e and unit tests pin the current strings; update them together.)

5. **MINOR** – `ReservationServiceImpl.java:59-77` – `futureOnly` is applied in JPQL for the phone path but in memory for the court/no-filter paths, so `findByCourtNumberOrderByCreatedAt` loads the complete history of a court and then discards most of it. Inconsistent and O(n) for a query the DB could filter. Fix: add `(boolean futureOnly, Instant now)` to `findByCourtNumberOrderByCreatedAt` / `findAllOrderByStartTime` (same pattern as `findByPhoneNumber`) and drop the stream filter; the both-filters branch can likewise be a JPQL `AND c.courtNumber = :courtNumber`.

6. **MINOR** – `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/dto/reservation/CreateReservationRequest.java:32` + `PhoneNumbers.java` – two-stage phone validation yields two different 400 shapes for the same field: `"abc"` → `errors.phoneNumber = "must be a phone number"` (Bean Validation), `"+421 9-0"` → `detail = "phoneNumber '+421 9-0' is not a valid ..."` with no `errors` map. The loose regex `^\+?[0-9 \-]{7,25}$` also accepts `"-------"`. Fix: a custom `@PhoneNumber` `ConstraintValidator` that normalises via `PhoneNumbers` and validates the strict pattern, so all phone errors land in `errors.phoneNumber`; keep `PhoneNumbers.normalise` for the service/lookup and for the `phoneNumber` query param.

7. **MINOR** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/service/impl/ReservationServiceImplTest.java` – boundary coverage gap: exactly `maxDuration` (240 min) being accepted is not tested anywhere (only 241 rejected, 5 h rejected in e2e); the exact-min boundary is covered only incidentally by `should_acceptStart_when_startEqualsNow`. Add `should_accept_when_durationEqualsMax` and a named `should_accept_when_durationEqualsMin`.

8. **MINOR** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/ReservationApiTest.java:316-332` – six independent invalid-interval scenarios in one `@Test`; the first failing `assertProblem` masks the others. Fix: `@ParameterizedTest` with `@MethodSource` (name still `should_return400_when_intervalInvalid`).

9. **MINOR** – `ReservationConcurrencyTest.java:82-88` duplicates `AbstractApiTest.cleanDatabase` verbatim (same four `DELETE`s, same FK order). Fix: extract a `DatabaseCleaner` test-support helper (or a non-web `AbstractIntegrationTest` base) used by both.

10. **NIT** – `ReservationConcurrencyTest.java:102` – `go.await(10, SECONDS)` return value is ignored; on timeout the thread proceeds anyway. Use `assertThat(go.await(...)).isTrue()` semantics or `go.await()` without timeout inside the callable (the outer `future.get(30s)` already bounds it).

11. **NIT** – `src/main/resources/application.yml:58-62` vs `src/test/resources/application-test.yml:8` – `jakarta.persistence.lock.timeout` stays 5000 while the test URL says `LOCK_TIMEOUT=2000`; harmless (H2 dialect ignores the hint, as the comment states) but the two values now disagree in the test profile. Either override the property in the test profile too or shorten the prod comment to say the property is documentary only.

12. **NIT** – `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/ReservationControllerTest.java:71` – `content().string(containsString("\"price\":180.00"))` and `jsonPath("$[0].price").value(180.00)` assert the same thing; keep one (the string form is the useful one, it proves the JSON number isn't rendered as `180.0`).

13. **NIT** – `ReservationServiceImpl.java:153-161` – Javadoc says a lock timeout is translated to `PessimisticLockingFailureException`; verified: the H2 path actually throws `org.hibernate.PessimisticLockException` → Spring `PessimisticLockingFailureException` (verify log shows the real chain), and the unit test uses the subclass `CannotAcquireLockException`. Correct, but add one sentence noting both subclasses are covered by the catch so a future reader doesn't "fix" it.

Reuse the default cached test context (no extra properties) so it is cheap.

`./mvnw -q verify` and `./mvnw -q test -Dsurefire.runOrder=alphabetical` must pass.

Files created/changed, verify results (test count, coverage), decisions/deviations.

**Kroky 2 až 6 sú hotové, každý prešiel revíziou, opravami a `./mvnw verify`, a sú commitnuté a pushnuté na vetve `claude/java-project-architecture-docs-mbchc0`.** Ďalej sú kroky 7 (security), 8 (správa užívateľov) a 9 (springdoc, README, UML, `docs/ai`). Čakám na tvoje OK alebo pripomienky.

| Stav | Hodnota |
|------|---------|
| Commity | Step 2 až Step 6, 81 súborov zmenených od kroku 1 |
| Testy | 301 spustených, 0 chýb, prechádzajú aj v alfabetickom poradí |
| JaCoCo | 99,8 % inštrukcie, 100 % riadky |
| Concurrency test | 3 opakovania bez zlyhania |

**Čo vzniklo po krokoch:**
- **Krok 2, DAO:** `GenericDao`/`AbstractDao` cez `EntityManager` + JPQL s explicitným `deleted = false`, štyri DAO (prekrývanie, zámok kurtu, nedokončené rezervácie), `MutableClock` a `Fixtures` pre testy.
- **Krok 3, číselník povrchov:** DTO, mapper, service, controller, RFC 7807 handler postavený na `ResponseEntityExceptionHandler` (aj 405, 415, neznáma cesta idú ako `application/problem+json`), dočasný permit-all `SecurityConfig` s TODO pre krok 7.
- **Krok 4, kurty:** CRUD s 409 pri duplicitnom čísle a pri nedokončenej rezervácii, `JOIN FETCH` povrchu, spoločná e2e základňa s čistením DB.
- **Krok 5, rezervácie:** `PriceCalculator`, vznik so zámkom kurtu pred kontrolou prekrývania, find-or-create zákazníka, RUD, filtre podľa kurtu a telefónu s `futureOnly`, `@PhoneNumber` validátor s normalizáciou, limity trvania v konfigurácii, test súbežnosti (dve vlákna, presne jedna rezervácia).
- **Krok 6, inicializácia dát:** `DataInitializer` cez service vrstvu, idempotentný, zapnutý v `dev` profile.

**Najdôležitejšie nálezy revízií a ich riešenie:**
- Stale `updatedAt` v PUT odpovedi: `AbstractDao.save` a `softDelete` teraz flushujú, takže audit časy sú v odpovedi správne.
- Zdieľaná H2 medzi testovacími kontextmi robila testy závislé od poradia: každý kontext má vlastnú DB (`random.uuid` v URL) a e2e testy čistia tabuľky.
- Súbežné prvé rezervácie s rovnakým novým telefónom by vytvorili dvoch zákazníkov a trvalo rozbili tento telefón: DB teraz vynucuje unikátnosť aktívnych kľúčov (telefón, číslo kurtu, názov povrchu) cez generované stĺpce `*_active` s unikátnym indexom, kolízia sa prekladá na 409.
- Blokovanie mazania kurtu alebo užívateľa používa `endTime > now`, takže blokuje aj prebiehajúcu rezerváciu.

## Findings

1. **MAJOR — user enumeration on login.** `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/security/RestAuthenticationEntryPoint.java:44-46` returns `"Account cannot log in"` for `DisabledException` but `"Invalid credentials"` for unknown/wrong password. `DaoAuthenticationProvider` runs the enabled check *before* the password check, so `POST /api/auth/login` with any password tells an anonymous caller whether a phone number is a registered customer (verified live: unknown number → "Invalid credentials", passwordless customer → "Account cannot log in"). Customer phone numbers are personal data. Fix: collapse `DisabledException` into `"Invalid credentials"` (or make `AppUserDetails.isEnabled()` always true and have `getPassword()` return a dummy non-matching hash so the failure is a `BadCredentialsException`); update `AuthApiTest:93`, `AuthControllerTest:101`, `RestAuthenticationEntryPointTest:59` and README accordingly.

2. **MINOR — HEAD/OPTIONS are ADMIN-only.** `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/config/SecurityConfig.java:86` matches only `HttpMethod.GET`; `HEAD /api/courts` (served by Spring MVC's GET handler) falls to line 88 and gives a USER 403 (verified live). HEAD is a read operation per the assignment. Fix: add `.requestMatchers(HttpMethod.HEAD, "/api/**").hasAnyRole(...)` (and decide OPTIONS explicitly).

3. **MINOR — `/h2-console/**` is public in every profile.** `SecurityConfig.java:40` and the global `frameOptions(sameOrigin)` at `:83` apply unconditionally; §5.6 says "iba dev profil" and README says "(dev profile)". Today the console is only *enabled* in `application-dev.yml`, so the effect is limited, but the security config does not enforce it and `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` is weakened for all API responses. Fix: bind the H2 entries to `spring.h2.console.enabled` (e.g. `@Value`/`AppProperties` flag or a separate `@Profile("dev")` chain for `/h2-console/**`) and keep `DENY` elsewhere.

4. **MINOR — no `WWW-Authenticate` header on 401.** `ProblemResponses.write` (`security/ProblemResponses.java:19-28`) never sets it; both the Basic and the Bearer entry points were replaced, so RFC 7235 §3.1 is violated (verified live: no header on either chain). Fix: set `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="tennis-club"` in the login chain and `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` (optionally with `error="invalid_token"`) in the API chain before writing the body.

5. **MINOR — package cycle `service` ↔ `security`.** `security/AppUserDetailsService.java:8` depends on `service.UserService`, while `service/impl/AuthServiceImpl.java:11-13` depends on `security.{AppUserDetails,JwtTokenService,TokenPair}` and constructs a Spring Security `UserDetails` adapter only to pass it to `JwtTokenService.issue`. ArchUnit does not catch cycles. Fix: `JwtTokenService.issue(AuthUser)` (or `issue(String phone, RoleDto role)`) so the service layer never touches `AppUserDetails`; alternatively move `JwtTokenService` under `service`.

6. **MINOR — refresh unit test does not prove "role in the new tokens is the current one".** `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/service/impl/AuthServiceImplTest.java:86-95` feeds a refresh JWT with `role=USER` for a user whose current role is ADMIN and only asserts the returned strings; the claim in the class Javadoc (`AuthServiceImpl.java:19`) is untested. Fix: capture the `AppUserDetails` passed to `issue` and assert `getRole() == ADMIN`.

7. **MINOR — bootstrap admin silently skipped when the phone belongs to a passwordless USER.** `config/AdminInitializer.java:29-31` logs at INFO "already exists" and returns even if the existing account cannot log in or is not ADMIN, which leaves the system with no admin at all. O-3 only says "create if not existing", so behaviour is spec-conformant; still, log at WARN with role/canLogin (never the password) so operators notice. Not tested either way.

8. **MINOR — untested paths.** No e2e test for login with an unknown phone (only the slice test with a mocked `UserDetailsService`), none for HEAD, none that `/h2-console` is public, and `AuthApiTest.should_return401Problem_when_loginWithWrongPasswordOrSpacedPhone` (`AuthApiTest.java:67-78`) bundles two unrelated scenarios under one `should_…_when_…` name. Split it and add the unknown-phone e2e (it becomes the regression test for finding 1).

9. **NIT — dead field.** `service/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:31-32` injects `Clock` "for step 8"; it is unused now (only referenced by the test constructor). Remove it until step 8 needs it.

10. **NIT — PII at INFO level.** `AuthServiceImpl.java:32,40` and `AdminInitializer.java:30,34` log full phone numbers on every login/refresh at INFO. Consider DEBUG or masking.

  abstract class BaseEntity <<MappedSuperclass>> {

    - createdAt : Instant
    - updatedAt : Instant
    - deleted : boolean
    - deletedAt : Instant
    + markDeleted(now : Instant)
  }
  class AuditListener <<EntityListener>> {
    - clock : Clock
    + onCreate(entity)
    + onUpdate(entity)
  }
  class SurfaceType {
    - name : String
    - pricePerMinute : BigDecimal
  }
  class Court {
    - courtNumber : Integer
    - name : String
  }
  class User {
    - phoneNumber : String
    - name : String
    - passwordHash : String
    - role : Role
  }
  class Reservation {
    - startTime : Instant
    - endTime : Instant
    - gameType : GameType
    - price : BigDecimal
  }
  enum Role { USER\nADMIN }
  enum GameType { SINGLES\nDOUBLES }

  BaseEntity <|-- SurfaceType
  BaseEntity <|-- Court
  BaseEntity <|-- User
  BaseEntity <|-- Reservation
  AuditListener .left.> BaseEntity : stamps
  Court "*" --> "1" SurfaceType : surfaceType
  Reservation "*" --> "1" Court : court
  Reservation "*" --> "1" User : user
  User --> Role
  Reservation --> GameType
}

package "dao" {
  interface GenericDao<T extends BaseEntity> {
    + findById(id) : Optional<T>

  GenericDao <|-- SurfaceTypeDao
  GenericDao <|-- CourtDao

  class PriceCalculator

AuthController --> AuthService

The `/me` rule is registered only for `HttpMethod.GET`; `HEAD /api/users/me` falls through to `USERS_PATHS` → `hasRole(ADMIN)`, so a USER gets 403 on HEAD while GET returns 200 (every other GET in the API is HEAD-readable for USER|ADMIN, and Spring MVC serves HEAD from the GET handler). Fix: `.requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, USERS_ME_PATH).hasAnyRole(...)` plus `.requestMatchers(HttpMethod.HEAD, USERS_ME_PATH).hasAnyRole(...)` before `USERS_PATHS`, and add a WebMvc test `should_return200_when_headMeAsUser`. (HEAD on `/api/users` and `/api/users/{id}` correctly remains ADMIN-only; the USER→403 case for `HEAD /api/users` is tested.)

2. **MINOR (recommendation)** — `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/service/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:96-119` — last-admin lockout is not prevented. An ADMIN can `PUT` themselves (or the only other admin) to `USER`, or delete the only other ADMIN then be demoted, leaving no account able to reach any admin endpoint (the bootstrap `AdminInitializer` only runs when configured). Not required by §5.5, but recommend: in `update`, when `user.getRole()==ADMIN && request.role()!=ADMIN`, and in `delete` when the target is ADMIN, check `userDao.countActiveAdmins() > 1` (new JPQL `COUNT(u) ... WHERE u.role='ADMIN' AND u.deleted=false`) and throw `ConflictException("... is the last administrator")`. Add unit + e2e tests.

3. **MINOR (note, no code change)** — role changes via `PUT /api/users/{id}` take effect only on the next login/refresh; an already-issued access token keeps the old `role` claim until expiry (the resource server authorises from the claim, not the DB). Same for demotion of an admin: their current token stays ADMIN. Document it in README next to the existing sentence about deleted users' tokens ("Deleting a user ..."), which currently only covers deletion.

4. **MINOR** — `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/UserApiTest.java:261-271` (`should_deleteUser_when_reservationIsAlreadyOver`) only asserts 204. O-9 requires that past reservations remain readable history: assert afterwards that `GET /api/reservations?phoneNumber=JANE_PHONE` (or by court) still returns the reservation and that `GET /api/users/{jane.id}` is 404. Without it the test does not distinguish soft delete from cascade.

5. **MINOR** — matrix coverage gaps in `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/UserControllerTest.java`: no anonymous 401 for `POST /api/users`, `PUT /api/users/{id}`, `GET /api/users/{id}` (only `GET /api/users`, `GET /me`, `DELETE` are covered). In `UserApiTest.java:172-173` anonymous is checked only for `GET /me` and `GET /api/users`. Add the missing `@WithAnonymousUser` cases (they are cheap and pin the "users rules before generic rules" ordering for every verb).

6. **MINOR** — `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/UserApiTest.java:299` — `admin().delete(BASE + "/" + first.id())` returns nothing and is unasserted; if delete silently returned 409/404 the subsequent `created(...)` would fail with a misleading duplicate-phone 409. Use `exchange(..., DELETE, ..., Void.class)` and assert `NO_CONTENT`.

7. **NIT** — `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/config/SecurityConfig.java:47` — `USERS_PATHS = {"/api/users", "/api/users/**"}`: with `PathPatternRequestMatcher` `/api/users/**` already matches `/api/users`; the first element is redundant. Keep one pattern.

8. **NIT** — `src/test/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/controller/UserApiTest.java:154` — `should_return403_when_userListsGetsCreatesUpdatesOrDeletes` also asserts two 401 anonymous cases (lines 172-173); either split them into `should_return401_when_anonymous...` or rename.

9. **NIT** — `src/main/java/sk/knizat/tennisclub/service/impl/UserServiceImpl.java:105-119` — no SLF4J logging at all for account create/update/delete (sensitive admin actions; `AuthServiceImpl` logs at debug). Add `log.info("Deleted user {}", id)` / `log.debug` for update (id + role only; never the password), matching the existing style. Also `existsUnfinishedByUser` uses `endTime > now`, i.e. blocks on ongoing as well as future reservations — spec says "budúce"; acceptable, but the `ConflictException` message ("unfinished") and README ("unfinished reservations") should be kept consistent with the court-delete wording in §5.3 (currently they are).

# Tennis Club Reservations

[![CI](https://github.com/OndrejKnizat/inqool_zadanie/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/OndrejKnizat/inqool_zadanie/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

REST API for managing a tennis club (InQool assignment, see [docs/zadanie.md](docs/zadanie.md)): a code list of
surface types with a price per minute, courts, court reservations with price calculation and overlap validation,
and JWT-secured user management. Built with Spring Boot 3.5 and Hibernate 6 through plain JPA (`EntityManager` +
JPQL, **no Spring Data**), H2 in-memory database and Liquibase migrations.

- Design specification: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) (data model, layers, endpoints, decisions)
- UML: [class diagram](docs/uml/class-diagram.svg), [sequence diagram of creating a reservation](docs/uml/sequence-create-reservation.svg),
  [package diagram](docs/uml/package-diagram.svg) (PlantUML sources in [docs/uml/](docs/uml/))
- AI-assisted development: [docs/ai/README.md](docs/ai/README.md) (workflow, files given to the agent, chat history)

## Assignment checklist

| Requirement / bonus | Where it is fulfilled |
|---------------------|-----------------------|
| Spring Boot | `pom.xml` (parent `spring-boot-starter-parent` 3.5), `TennisClubApplication` |
| JPA / Hibernate as ORM | `hibernate-core` + `spring-orm` + `spring-boot-starter-jdbc`; entities in `entity/`, `ddl-auto=validate` |
| In-memory database | H2 (`jdbc:h2:mem:tennis`), `application.yml` |
| DAO **without** Spring Data JPA | `dao/GenericDao`, `dao/AbstractDao` (`EntityManager` + JPQL) and `dao/impl/*`; enforced by the Maven enforcer rule (`org.springframework.data:*` banned) and the ArchUnit rule `no_spring_data_dependency` in `ArchitectureTest` |
| Unit tests covering at least 90 % | JaCoCo `check` (INSTRUCTION and LINE ≥ 90 %) runs in `./mvnw verify`; currently 462 tests, 99.9 % instruction and 100 % line coverage (`target/site/jacoco/index.html`) |
| Every endpoint under `/api` | all controllers in `controller/`, see [Endpoint reference](#endpoint-reference) |
| Surface type code list managed by the user | `SurfaceTypeController` CRUD (`/api/surface-types`) |
| CRUD courts, RUD reservations | `CourtController`, `ReservationController` |
| Reservations by court number ordered by creation date | `GET /api/reservations?courtNumber=` (`ReservationDaoImpl.findByCourtNumber`, `ORDER BY createdAt`) |
| Reservations by phone number, optionally future only | `GET /api/reservations?phoneNumber=&futureOnly=true` |
| Create reservation with court, game type, phone, name; returns price; overlap validation | `POST /api/reservations` → `ReservationServiceImpl.create` + `PriceCalculator` (doubles ×1.5); overlap → `400` |
| Customer created on first reservation, same name per phone | `ReservationServiceImpl.findOrCreateCustomer` |
| Soft delete over all entities | `BaseEntity.markDeleted`, every JPQL filters `deleted = false`, `em.remove` is never used (ArchUnit + `AbstractDaoTest`) |
| Data initialisation switch in external configuration | `app.data-init.enabled` → `config/DataInitializer` (2 surface types, 4 courts) |
| UML and class diagram in the repository | `docs/uml/` |
| AI chat history and files given to the agent | `docs/ai/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| Bonus: Liquibase | `src/main/resources/db/changelog/` (schema exclusively from changelogs) |
| Bonus: Lombok | `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor` on entities, `@RequiredArgsConstructor`, `@Slf4j`; `lombok.config` |
| Bonus: 400 on bad requests (e.g. invalid reservation) | Bean Validation + `GlobalExceptionHandler` (RFC 7807), `ValidationException` for interval/overlap rules |
| Bonus: user management | `UserController` (`/api/users`), bootstrap admin (`config/AdminInitializer`) |
| Bonus: roles USER (read + create reservation) / ADMIN (everything) | `config/SecurityConfig` matcher, `security/AccessTokenAuthenticationConverter` |
| Bonus: JWT on all endpoints except `/api/auth/*` | `SecurityConfig` (OAuth2 resource server, HS256), `security/JwtTokenService` |
| Bonus: login via Basic auth on `POST /api/auth/login`, token in the `Authorization` header | `AuthController.login` (`Authorization: Bearer <access>` header + body) |
| Bonus: JWT secret, access and refresh validity in external configuration | `app.security.jwt.*` (`APP_JWT_SECRET`, ...), see [Configuration](#configuration) |
| Bonus: 401 for missing/expired/invalid token, 403 for insufficient role | `security/RestAuthenticationEntryPoint`, `security/RestAccessDeniedHandler`; `AuthApiTest`, `H2ConsoleSecurityTest`, controller API tests |

## Tech stack

Java 21 · Spring Boot 3.5 (Web, Validation, Security, OAuth2 resource server) · Hibernate 6 (JPA) · H2 · Liquibase ·
Lombok · springdoc-openapi (Swagger UI) · JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, ArchUnit, JaCoCo · Maven wrapper.

## Prerequisites

- JDK 21 only (Maven is bundled via the wrapper `./mvnw`; on Windows use `mvnw.cmd`).

## Build, test, run

```bash
./mvnw verify                                             # compile, all tests, ArchUnit, JaCoCo 90 % gate
./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev     # run on :8080 with dev defaults (see Profiles)
./mvnw package -DskipTests && java -jar target/tennis-club-reservations-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --spring.profiles.active=dev
```

After start:

- Swagger UI: <http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html> (OpenAPI JSON at `/v3/api-docs`). Click **Authorize**:
  `basicAuth` for the login operation, `bearerAuth` (paste the access token) for everything else.
- H2 console (`dev` profile only): <http://localhost:8080/h2-console>, JDBC URL `jdbc:h2:mem:tennis`, user `sa`,
  empty password.
- JaCoCo report after `verify`: `target/site/jacoco/index.html`.

### Profiles

| Profile | Behaviour |
|---------|-----------|
| *(default)* | production-like: `APP_JWT_SECRET` (≥ 32 characters) **must** be set or the application fails fast at startup; data initialisation off; H2 console off |
| `dev` | built-in development JWT secret, `app.data-init.enabled=true`, H2 console enabled |
| `test` | used by the test suite (`src/test/resources/application-test.yml`) |

## Configuration

All `app.*` properties (bound to `config/AppProperties`) can be overridden with environment variables.

**Čo pribudlo v krokoch 7 až 9:**
- **Krok 7, security:** BCrypt účty, Basic login na `POST /api/auth/login` s tokenom v hlavičke `Authorization` aj v tele, stateless refresh, HS256 resource server s role matrix, 401/403 ako `application/problem+json` s `WWW-Authenticate`, bootstrap admin z konfigurácie, H2 konzola verejná iba keď je zapnutá (dev). Revízia odhalila enumeráciu telefónov cez rozdielne 401 hlášky, zjednotené na „Invalid credentials“.
- **Krok 8, správa užívateľov:** `/api/users` CRUD pre ADMIN, `/api/users/me` pre každého, ochrana pred zmazaním seba, posledného admina a užívateľa s nedokončenými rezerváciami.
- **Krok 9, dokumentácia:** README s kontrolným zoznamom zadania, prehľadom endpointov a overeným curl návodom, UML diagramy (class, sekvenčný pre vznik rezervácie, balíky) ako PlantUML zdroj + SVG/PNG v `docs/uml`, ARCHITECTURE.md zosúladený s kódom a doplnený o sekciu 10 „Realizačné odchýlky“, OpenAPI popis a `@ApiResponse` anotácie, ArchUnit pravidlo proti `em.remove`, GitHub Actions workflow s `./mvnw verify`.

**Čo zostáva na tebe pred odovzdaním:**
- **Export histórie AI komunikácie** do `docs/ai/` ako `session-*.md` (zadanie to vyžaduje, `docs/ai/README.md` popisuje konvenciu a pracovný postup). K vlastnej histórii nemám prístup.
- Zlúčiť vetvu do `main` (alebo poslať odkaz na vetvu) a po prvom pushi do GitHubu skontrolovať, že CI workflow prebehol zeleno (badge v README ukazuje na `ci.yml`).
- Voliteľne premenovať bootstrap admina a heslo cez `APP_SECURITY_ADMIN_*` / `APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD`, ak nechceš dev default `+420000000000` / `admin`.

Poznámka k správaniu, ktoré si možno budeš chcieť overiť: história zmazaného zákazníka je čitateľná cez zoznam podľa kurtu, zoznam podľa telefónu vracia iba nezmazaných zákazníkov.

content: Lokálny mvnw.cmd clean verify na čistom klone na Windows s JDK 25.0.2 zlyhal s 85 kompilačnými chybami - všetky sú chýbajúce Lombok getre/setre/log. Od JDK 23 javac nespúšťa anotačné procesory z classpath bez explicitnej konfigurácie. Oprav to v pom.xml cez annotationProcessorPaths v maven-compiler-plugin (Lombok + spring-boot-configuration-processor), aby build fungoval na novsich JDK. Potom over ./mvnw clean verify a commitni.

11	Fixné požiadavky (nie sú predmetom diskusie):
12	
13	| # | Požiadavka |
14	|---|------------|
15	| 1 | DAO vrstva výhradne cez `EntityManager` + JPQL, generický `AbstractDao`. Spring Data JPA zakázané, vynútené ArchUnit testom. |
16	| 2 | Vrstvy controller → service → dao. DTO na hraniciach, entita nikdy v response. |
17	| 3 | Soft delete cez `BaseEntity` + explicitné filtrovanie v DAO. |
18	| 4 | Java 21, Spring Boot 3, H2, Maven, JaCoCo s limitom 90 % vo fáze `verify`. |

21	---
22	
23	## 1. Technologický stack
24	
25	| Oblasť | Voľba | Poznámka |
26	|--------|-------|----------|
27	| Jazyk / build | Java 21, Maven | Maven wrapper (`mvnw`) v repozitári |
28	| Framework | Spring Boot 3.5.x | posledná 3.x línia |
29	| Web | `spring-boot-starter-web`, `spring-boot-starter-validation` | REST + Bean Validation |
30	| ORM | Hibernate 6 cez `spring-boot-starter-jdbc` + `hibernate-core` + `spring-orm` | **nie** `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa` (ťahá Spring Data). Auto-konfigurácia `HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration` funguje aj bez Spring Data. |
31	| DB | H2 in-memory | `jdbc:h2:mem:tennis` |
32	| Migrácie | Liquibase (bonus) | `ddl-auto=validate`, schéma výhradne z changelogu |
33	| Boilerplate | Lombok (bonus) | `lombok.config` s `lombok.addLombokGeneratedAnnotation=true` (JaCoCo ignoruje generovaný kód) |
34	| Security | Spring Security 6 + `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server` (Nimbus JWT, HS256) | bez tretej JWT knižnice, viď otázka O-11 |
35	| API dokumentácia | springdoc-openapi | Swagger UI, viď otázka O-19 |
36	| Testy | JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, Spring Boot Test, ArchUnit | |
37	| Coverage | JaCoCo, `check` viazaný na `verify`, minimum 90 % | |
38	| Enforcement | maven-enforcer-plugin `bannedDependencies` na `org.springframework.data:*` | druhá poistka popri ArchUnit |
39	
40	---
41	
42	## 2. Dátový model
43	
44	### 2.1 Prehľad
45	
46	```mermaid
47	classDiagram
48	    class BaseEntity {
49	        <<MappedSuperclass>>
50	        +Long id
51	        +Instant createdAt
52	        +Instant updatedAt
53	        +boolean deleted
54	        +Instant deletedAt
55	    }
56	    class SurfaceType {
57	        +String name
58	        +BigDecimal pricePerMinute
59	    }
60	    class Court {
61	        +Integer courtNumber
62	        +String name
63	    }
64	    class User {
65	        +String phoneNumber
66	        +String name
67	        +String passwordHash
68	        +Role role
69	    }
70	    class Reservation {
71	        +Instant startTime
72	        +Instant endTime
73	        +GameType gameType
74	        +BigDecimal price
75	    }
76	    class Role {
77	        <<enumeration>>
78	        USER
79	        ADMIN
80	    }
81	    class GameType {
82	        <<enumeration>>
83	        SINGLES
84	        DOUBLES
85	    }
86	    BaseEntity <|-- SurfaceType
87	    BaseEntity <|-- Court
88	    BaseEntity <|-- User
89	    BaseEntity <|-- Reservation
90	    Court "*" --> "1" SurfaceType : surfaceType
91	    Reservation "*" --> "1" Court : court
92	    Reservation "*" --> "1" User : user
93	    User --> Role
94	    Reservation --> GameType
95	```
96	
97	### 2.2 Entity
98	
99	**`BaseEntity`** (`@MappedSuperclass`)
100	
101	| Atribút | Typ | Poznámka |
102	|---------|-----|----------|
103	| `id` | `Long`, `@GeneratedValue(IDENTITY)` | |
104	| `createdAt` | `Instant` | nastaví `entity.AuditListener` (`@PrePersist`) z injektovaného `Clock` beanu (nie Spring Data auditing) |
105	| `updatedAt` | `Instant` | nastaví `entity.AuditListener` (`@PreUpdate`) |
106	| `deleted` | `boolean`, default `false` | soft delete flag |
107	| `deletedAt` | `Instant`, nullable | čas zmazania |
108	
109	Metóda `markDeleted(Instant now)` nastaví `deleted=true` a `deletedAt=now` (čas dodá service z `Clock` beanu; idempotentná). Audit polia a soft-delete polia nemajú settery. `equals/hashCode` podľa `id` s odbalením Hibernate proxy (`Hibernate.getClass`), `hashCode` stabilný aj pred priradením id (bez Lombok `@Data`; entity majú iba `@Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor`).
110	
111	**`SurfaceType`** – číselník povrchov, spravovateľný cez API
112	
113	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
114	|---------|-----|------------|
115	| `name` | `String` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými |
116	| `pricePerMinute` | `BigDecimal(10,2)` | povinné, `>= 0` |
117	
118	**`Court`**
119	
120	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
121	|---------|-----|------------|
122	| `courtNumber` | `Integer` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými, biznisový identifikátor z API ("unikátne číslo kurtu") |
123	| `name` | `String` | nepovinné (napr. „Centre court“) |
124	| `surfaceType` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné, iba nezmazaný povrch |
125	
126	**`User`** – zákazník aj systémový účet v jednom (viď O-1)
127	
128	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
129	|---------|-----|------------|
130	| `phoneNumber` | `String` | povinné, unikátne medzi nezmazanými, login identifikátor |
131	| `name` | `String` | povinné |
132	| `passwordHash` | `String`, nullable | BCrypt; `null` = účet nemôže sa prihlásiť (zákazník vytvorený rezerváciou) |
133	| `role` | `enum Role {USER, ADMIN}` | default `USER` |
134	
135	**`Reservation`**
136	
137	| Atribút | Typ | Obmedzenie |
138	|---------|-----|------------|
139	| `court` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné |
140	| `user` | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` | povinné (zákazník) |
141	| `startTime`, `endTime` | `Instant` | `start < end`, polootvorený interval `[start, end)` |
142	| `gameType` | `enum GameType {SINGLES, DOUBLES}` | povinné |
143	| `price` | `BigDecimal(10,2)` | snapshot vypočítanej ceny v čase vzniku/úpravy (viď O-6) |
144	
145	Zoradenie „podľa dátumu vytvorenia“ používa `createdAt` z `BaseEntity`.
146	
147	### 2.3 Biznisové pravidlá
148	
149	- **Cena** = `minúty × pricePerMinute × (1.5 ak DOUBLES)`, zaokrúhlené `HALF_UP` na 2 desatinné miesta. Minúty = `Duration.between(start, end).toMinutes()`.
150	- **Prekrývanie**: rezervácia `R` koliduje s `X` na tom istom kurte, ak `R.start < X.end AND R.end > X.start` (pri nezmazaných `X`). Dotyk intervalov (`R.end == X.start`) nie je kolízia. Pri update sa vylučuje vlastné `id`.
151	- **Zákazník**: pri vzniku rezervácie sa hľadá nezmazaný `User` podľa telefónu; ak neexistuje, vytvorí sa s `role=USER`, `passwordHash=null`.
152	- **Soft delete**: nikdy `em.remove()`. DAO dotazy majú vždy podmienku `e.deleted = false`; `findById` vracia `Optional.empty()` pre zmazané.
153	
154	### 2.4 Liquibase
155	
156	`db/changelog/db.changelog-master.yaml` → `001-initial-schema.yaml` (tabuľky `surface_type`, `court`, `app_user`, `reservation`, FK, indexy na `reservation(court_id, start_time, end_time)`, `app_user(phone_number)`, `court(court_number)`) a `002-active-unique-keys.yaml`: generované stĺpce `name_active`, `court_number_active`, `phone_number_active` (hodnota kľúča pre nezmazaný riadok, `NULL` pre zmazaný) s unikátnym indexom. Tým DB vynucuje unikátnosť biznisových kľúčov iba medzi nezmazanými riadkami (O-8); service kontroluje duplicitu vopred (409) a kolíziu z DB prekladá na 409 (`UniqueKeys.saveOrConflict`).

content.text: Doplním `annotationProcessorPaths` do `maven-compiler-plugin` (Lombok + `spring-boot-configuration-processor`, verzie z rodičovského BOM), spustím `./mvnw clean verify` a commitnem.

input.command:
set -e
cd /home/user/inqool_zadanie
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='pom.xml'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
old="""        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>"""
new="""        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Since JDK 23 javac no longer runs annotation processors found on the classpath unless they
                         are configured explicitly; list them so the build works on newer JDKs as well as on 21. -->
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
                        </path>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                            <artifactId>spring-boot-configuration-processor</artifactId>
                            <version>${project.parent.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1); open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
p='README.md'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
old="- JDK 21 only (Maven is bundled via the wrapper `./mvnw`; on Windows use `mvnw.cmd`)."
new="- JDK 21 or newer (verified with 21 and 25; annotation processors are configured explicitly, as JDK 23+ no longer\n  picks them up from the classpath). Maven is bundled via the wrapper `./mvnw`; on Windows use `mvnw.cmd`."
assert old in s; open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s.replace(old,new,1))
EOF

Čo sa zmenilo:
- V `pom.xml` má `maven-compiler-plugin` explicitné `annotationProcessorPaths` s Lombokom (`${lombok.version}`) a `spring-boot-configuration-processor` (`${project.parent.version}`), obe verzie riadi rodičovský BOM Spring Boot 3.5.16. Komentár vysvetľuje dôvod (JDK 23+ nespúšťa procesory z classpath).
- README v prerekvizitách uvádza JDK 21 alebo novší a túto konfiguráciu.

Overenie: `./mvnw clean verify` prešiel (462 testov, JaCoCo limit splnený) a `target/classes/META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json` sa generuje, takže bežia oba procesory. Overené tu na JDK 21; na JDK 25 by mal `mvnw.cmd clean verify` na čistom klone prejsť, daj vedieť, ak nie.

lastPrompt: Lokálny mvnw.cmd clean verify na čistom klone na Windows s JDK 25.0.2 zlyhal s 85 kompilačnými chybami - všetky sú chýbajúce Lombok getre/setre/log. Od JDK 23 javac nespúšťa anotačné procesory z class…

1. Najdi transkripty v ~/.claude/projects/. Zahrn hlavny .jsonl aj vsetky subory sub agentov. Over ze hlavny transkript zacina mojou prvou spravou so zadanim pre architekturu.
